highlights.text: Run agents from channels, group chats or direct messages, with thread replies continuing the same session.
Share connector accounts with specific groups, specific people or everyone in a project.
Mobile push notifications alert you when a turn completes, fails, asks a question or needs permission, even while the app is closed.
Saved transcripts and attachments load without waking the sandbox.
Sessions retry transient model errors and continue through short provider outages instead of stopping.
